topic: Day 37 — carousel — You can't be intimate while performing for someone

slides.text: The curated version of you leaves no room for contact.
Performance and vulnerability pull in opposite directions.
The more polished the presentation, the less real the closeness.

caption:
The version of you optimized for approval is a barrier to closeness, not a bridge to it.

Follow for one of these a day.
